additional_info.subject: Report of connectors showing an unavailable status Sicharge D Charging Station – S/N:   MP/R6 170002081
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to report an issue with a Sicharge D charging station, serial number MP/R6 170002081.
Issue observed:
The station has been in an "connector out of operation" on the charge point, "available" on the connector 1 DC CCS plug, 160kW and "unavailable" on the connector 2 DC CCS plug,160kW,  since June 30, 2025 at 19:46:12, which is the time of the last status change.
Please investigate and take the necessary actions as soon as possible. We would also appreciate a report on the root cause and any corrective measures planned.
Best regards,
Janusan ESVARANATHAN | Supervision and maintenance engineer | Mob: +33 745 654 964
